title: Code doesn't work with fee on transfer tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, core functionality would be broken.  **Likelihood:** Low, having fee-on-transfer token is a probable scenario.  ## Description  There are some places in the code that assume the ERC20 transfer function will transfer a specified `amount` and this is not true for tokens with fee. This will cause wrong calculation results in those cases. Some of the places where this issue happens:  1.
